| # XCP Access-Right {#xcp-access-right-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+

Enabling the XCP interface in a series device should be avoided whenever possible. Once the XCP interface is enabled, arbitrary memory addresses can be accessed and modified, potentially leading to a malfunctioning and compromised device. The XCP interface should be used only for development purposes and in non-productive devices in a secure environment.
